title: Beyond Bias Scores: Unmasking Vacuous Neutrality in Small Language Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly benchmarks and evaluates religious bias as one of its primary social bias categories. It uses the BBQ, StereoSet, and CrowS-Pairs datasets which include 'Religion' as a demographic dimension, and the results for this category are featured prominently in the paper's heatmaps (Figures 2, 3, 5, 6) and data tables (Tables 5 through 11).
